items.title: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say
items.description: The US-Iran talks began on Sunday in Switzerland, after last week's agreement, which includes a commitment to reach a final deal within 60 days.

items.title: Trump-backed political outsider wins Colombia election, initial count shows
items.description: Abelardo de la Espriella appears to have narrowly defeated his rival Iván Cepeda, who says the preliminary count is "not yet official or binding".

items.title: Largest ever cocaine bust in Australia after police raid underground bunker
items.description: Police seized 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated A$816m after searching a property in western Sydney.

items.title: Russian troop build-up threatens city seen as key to seizing Ukraine's Donbas
items.description: If Kostyantynivka falls, Russian forces would be able push towards Ukraine's last remaining strongholds in the east.

items.title: Alan Greenspan, architect of the modern American economy, dies aged 100
items.description: As chairman of the Federal Reserve, Alan Greenspan became the world's most high-profile banker.

items.title: Former Kenyan justice minister blocked from entering Uganda, lawyers' body says
items.description: Martha  Karua is a lawyer representing detained Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye who is on trial for treason.

items.title: Schools close as more than half of France under red heat alerts
items.description: The health minister warns many citizens "will suffer", with temperatures set to peak on Monday.

items.title: Japan quintuples visa fees in first price hike since 1978
items.description: Authorities say they do not expect the hikes to have an "immediate impact on inbound tourism".

items.title: Late singer Oliver Tree's body returned to US after helicopter crash
items.description: The 32-year-old California native died whilst on his world tour, ahead of a date in Brazil.

items.title: Three dead in Philippines high school shooting over bullying 'grudge'
items.description: Police say they believe the attack was motivated by a "grudge" over bullying.

items.title: Cape Verde fan goes wild live on BBC News as his country scores
items.description: During a live BBC News broadcast, reporter Paul Njie interviews a Cape Verde fan when the country suddenly scores its first ever World Cup goal against Uruguay in the 2026 World Cup.

items.title: Trump says repairs to algae-plagued Reflecting Pool will begin immediately
items.description: Despite a multi-million dollar renovation, the Washington DC landmark has peeling paint and algae. Trump claims vandals are partly to blame.
